sentences.text: Nyx, a 7-year-old female Domestic Shorthair with neuter status not recorded, has a live safety flag: the AI photo read of the May 23 vomit noted a possible plastic fragment, unconfirmed, and the photo was not retained.
Vomiting was entered on 4 of the 7 days to Jun 30, her latest entries, and on 23 of 43 logged days over at least 47 days, first logged May 14, her first entry of any kind, with onset unknown.
Her two free-fed bowls, start not recorded, have intake not directly observed, and no food could be isolated: chicken is in her all-day kibble, so treat days cannot be tested apart from it.
18 of 23 vomit entries have a legible AI photo read, unconfirmed and with no photos retained, and 5 have no usable read.
Weight, medication, medical conditions and neuter status are not recorded, the record is logged on 43 of 90 days, and nothing is logged Jul 1 to 2.
